service.en: Issue an economic licence: Dual licence and branches

service.ur: اقتصادی لائسنس کا اجرا: دوہرا لائسنس اور شاخیں
service.ml: സാമ്പത്തിക ലൈസൻസ് നൽകൽ: ഡ്യുവൽ ലൈസൻസും ശാഖകളും

about: Let an existing company open a branch or dual licence in Abu Dhabi with the parent company's legal form and activities.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: An existing company opening a branch with the same legal form and activities as the parent
fees: 790 AED for up to 6 activities, plus 100 AED for each activity after the sixth
600 AED Chamber membership for branches, 2,200 AED for foreign branches
timing: Other entities may need to approve too
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
